    Polygons from branching morphisms #

    Let w : a → b be a nonzero morphism in a directed algebra with one-dimensional corners. Suppose that w factors through at least two points n j (the first points of the arms), and that the sets of points through which w factors after n j are disjoint. Then the points through which w factors form a polygon (polyOfData).
